## Empowering a sustainable future for our planet

Agilent supports more than 285,000 laboratories across 110 countries—advancing scientific discovery
and innovation on a global scale.

The Agilent Foundation partners with organizations that advance STEM education, promote global
wellbeing, and build climate resilience.

Agilent is advancing science with purpose—embedding circular economy principles to drive sustainable
innovation and long-term impact.

Agilent is deepening its collaboration with My Green Lab as a top-tier Transformative Sponsor, while
expanding our portfolio of ACT-labeled products to support more sustainable science.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

[AGILE ICON][AGILE ICON]

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

## What Sets Us Apart

[AGILE ICON][AGILE ICON]

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Move Faster

### Bioinformatics workflows made easy

DNAnexus allows teams to move quickly with a platform optimized for speed, cutting down the time
spent deploying a new pipeline by 40%.

  Support for multiple workflow languages (Nextflow, WDL) and the ability to integrate your own
  tools (Docker) and reuse pipelines instantly.
* [optimized for wet and dry lab]
  
  ### Optimized for Wet and Dry Lab
  
  Bioinformatics developers can use our native CLI while non-technical teams can access an intuitive
  user interface for a streamlined experience.
* [pre-built tools]

  Access a library of pre-built tools and apps to save time and accelerate analyses.

### Derive rich insights from precision health data

tools, JupyterLab notebooks, cohort browsing, and visualization applications–all within the DNAnexus
platform.

[cohort-phenotypic-data-platform-image]

  ### Multiomics and Multimodal Data Management
  
  Access prebuilt apps for ingesting germline, somatic, and RNA secondary analysis data into
  structured databases for effortless querying, and easily link them to medical data.

  ### AI and Machine Learning
  
  Seamlessly deploy AI and machine learning algorithms within a secure environment to run predictive
  analytics, accelerate insight generation and improve decision-making.

  ### Cohort Analysis and Data Visualization
  
  Use our powerful cohort browser and integrated JupyterLab notebooks to enable deep dataset
  analysis. Easily slice and dice datasets to analyze data you need, when you need it.

###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

instrument.

[LEARN ABOUT VELSERA][29]

## The power of connection

Seven Bridges is the leading biomedical data company, specializing in software and data analytics to
drive public and private healthcare research.

We deliver end-to-end bioinformatic solutions — including access to datasets, analytic workflows and
algorithms, cloud-computing infrastructure, and scientific support — that speed the path from raw
experimental data to new treatments and diagnostics.

Use Seven Bridges to discover more from your genomic and clinical data with immediate access to more
public datasets and bioinformatics tools than anywhere else.

#### [**COLLABORATION **][30]

Connect teams and data to fuel collaborative research and development in a cloud-based environment.

#### [**DISCOVERY **][31]

Organize, explore, and empower omics data with new bioinformatic workflows and algorithms.
Streamline clinical trial research and increase speed to market.

#### [**DATA & COMPUTE **][32]

Immediate access to flexible and reproducible computation, centralized data storage, and diverse
public datasets.

#### [**SECURITY & COMPLIANCE **][33]

# Experts in **genomics**

AllGenetics' expertise in high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics ensures that we understand
your research needs to deliver high-quality results in an easy, personalised format.

[ [icon] Genomics for researchers ][51]

protocols and bioinformatics processes to your specific needs.]

## WE ADAPT—
## **SO YOU DON'T HAVE TO**

We tailor our lab protocols and bioinformatic pipelines to your specific needs. Our team will be by
your side from project design to data interpretation, answering questions as they arise.

[The image is a green icon indicating that, as a general rule, at AllGenetics we help you get the
most out of your samples: before, during, and after analysis.]

## YOUR ANALYSES
## **ARE IN EXPERIENCED HANDS**

You can rely on our team's extensive expertise. We help you get the most from your samples—before,
during, and after analysis.

[The image is a green icon indicating that, as a general rule, AllGenetics tailors its laboratory
protocols and bioinformatics processes to your specific needs.]

## WE CARE
## **ABOUT YOUR PROJECT**

Your dedicated project specialist is available during working hours. You'll work with real
scientists who are involved in your project—not machines sending automatic analysis reports.

## Your trusted **genomics company**

At AllGenetics we take pride in being a highly regarded genomic solutions partner since our
establishment in 2011. Our medium-sized team of highly skilled experts will work closely with you to
provide customised solutions to help you answer your research questions.

# Bioinformatics Made Easy

[ Book a Demo ][38]
[ [kegg omicsbox] ][39]

## Your All-In-One Bioinformatics Software Solution

### Over 15k researchers choose OmicsBox for their projects!

OmicsBox is the leading bioinformatics solution that offers end-to-end NGS data analysis of genomes,
transcriptomes, and metagenomes.

We have designed OmicsBox to be user-friendly, efficient, and with a powerful set of tools to
extract biological insights from omics data.

OmicsBox is used by top private and public research institutions worldwide. It allows researchers to
easily process large and complex data sets, and streamline their analysis process. 

[ Discover OmicsBox ][40]

## Five modules to easily process large and complex data sets

### From raw reads to functional insights fast and easy

## [Functional Analysis][41]

Functionally annotate and analyze any sequence dataset from scratch.

[ Read More ][42]

## [Transcriptomics][43]

Convert your RNA-Seq samples into Biological Insights.

[ Read More ][44]

## [Genetic Variation][45]

Identify and analyze genetic variations within a population or a species.

[ Read More ][46]

## [Metagenomics][47]

Allows different types of microbiome analysis like assembly and taxonomic classification.

[ Read More ][48]

## [Genome Analysis][49]

Easily convert raw DNA-Seq reads into a structurally annotated and curated draft genome.

[ Read More ][50]

## Bioinformatics, simplified. Focus on what matters.

### Designed for Scientists: Analyze. Visualize. Interpret.
* No coding or programming skills needed
* Easy to use: end-to-end, modular design
* Process large datasets with cloud support vía OmicsCloud
* Flexible licensing for labs and institutions
* Features always up-to-date: free updates and improvements
* Dedicated support team: 48h response for issues
* Management Dashboard for susbscription and users

[ Discover OmicsBox ][51]

## Over 900 Institutions around the world trust OmicsBox

[ Book a Demo ][52]

## Take your research to the next level with OmicsBox

[ [freetr2Recurso 7] ][53]

**Try OmicsBox**

Experience a full-featured OmicsBox for one week.

[ Start Trial ][54]
[ [susRecurso 10] ][55]

**Subscribe to OmicsBox**

Design workflows, run analysis and visualize results.

[ Get OmicsBox ][56]
[ [idRecurso 11] ][57]

**Tutorial, Videos, News**

Browse our Blog for case studies and videos.

[ Read Blog ][58]

## Get to Know Us

BioBam is a leading bioinformatics solution provider which accelerates research in disciplines such
as agricultural genomics, microbiology, and environmental NGS studies, amongst others.

At BioBam we are committed to the development of user-friendly software solutions for biological
research. Our mission is to transform complex data analysis procedures into attractive and
interactive tasks. Our ultimate goal is to close the gap between experimental work, bioinformatics
analysis, and applied research.

[ More About BioBam ][59]

# Bioinformatics Made Easy

[ Book a Demo ][38]
[ [kegg omicsbox] ][39]

## Your All-In-One Bioinformatics Software Solution

### Over 15k researchers choose OmicsBox for their projects!

OmicsBox is the leading bioinformatics solution that offers end-to-end NGS data analysis of genomes,
transcriptomes, and metagenomes.

We have designed OmicsBox to be user-friendly, efficient, and with a powerful set of tools to
extract biological insights from omics data.

OmicsBox is used by top private and public research institutions worldwide. It allows researchers to
easily process large and complex data sets, and streamline their analysis process. 

[ Discover OmicsBox ][40]

## Five modules to easily process large and complex data sets

### From raw reads to functional insights fast and easy

## [Functional Analysis][41]

Functionally annotate and analyze any sequence dataset from scratch.

[ Read More ][42]

## [Transcriptomics][43]

Convert your RNA-Seq samples into Biological Insights.

[ Read More ][44]

## [Genetic Variation][45]

Identify and analyze genetic variations within a population or a species.

[ Read More ][46]

## [Metagenomics][47]

Allows different types of microbiome analysis like assembly and taxonomic classification.

[ Read More ][48]

## [Genome Analysis][49]

Easily convert raw DNA-Seq reads into a structurally annotated and curated draft genome.

[ Read More ][50]

## Bioinformatics, simplified. Focus on what matters.

### Designed for Scientists: Analyze. Visualize. Interpret.
* No coding or programming skills needed
* Easy to use: end-to-end, modular design
* Process large datasets with cloud support vía OmicsCloud
* Flexible licensing for labs and institutions
* Features always up-to-date: free updates and improvements
* Dedicated support team: 48h response for issues
* Management Dashboard for susbscription and users

[ Discover OmicsBox ][51]

## Over 900 Institutions around the world trust OmicsBox

[ Book a Demo ][52]

[ Get OmicsBox ][56]
[ [idRecurso 11] ][57]

**Tutorial, Videos, News**

Browse our Blog for case studies and videos.

[ Read Blog ][58]

## Get to Know Us

BioBam is a leading bioinformatics solution provider which accelerates research in disciplines such
as agricultural genomics, microbiology, and environmental NGS studies, amongst others.

At BioBam we are committed to the development of user-friendly software solutions for biological
research. Our mission is to transform complex data analysis procedures into attractive and
interactive tasks. Our ultimate goal is to close the gap between experimental work, bioinformatics
analysis, and applied research.

pipelines, reproducible statistics and domain knowledge to help you identify patterns that are
biologically meaningful.

* Single-cell and spatial data analysis
* Custom reports, figures and reproducible workflows

hypotheses and prepare results for decisions, grants and high-impact publications.

Our team combines classical bioinformatics with machine learning approaches for pattern discovery,
data integration and scalable analysis systems.

path.

# Epigenomics Sequencing

We offer dozens of technologies to help you study the effects of epigenomic modifications that cause
diseases and disorders in plants, animals and humans.

Explore now
][199]
[

## SNP Genotyping

With our services you can either take a deep look into the genome and search for unknown
genotype-phenotype connections or genotype already known variations.

Explore now
][200]
[

## PacBio SMRT Sequencing

With longer reads, we can sequence through extended repetitive regions and detect mutations，
sequence full-length transcripts or fragments with significant lengths and provide information on
genome-wide DNA modification.

Explore now
][201]
[

## Metagenomics Solution

We offer a suite of metagenomics solutions ranging from targeted assays (16S for prokaryotes and
ITS2 for fungi) to whole genome analysis.

Explore now
][202]

## Explore Areas of Interest

Rooted in extensive experience in DNA and RNA sequencing, a deep understanding of molecular biology,
and a wealth of bioinformatics knowledge, CD Genomics has been working with the world's leaders in
pharmaceutical and biotechnology. We are capable of assisting your projects in the following areas:

[

circRNA sequencing, lncRNA sequencing, etc.

Unprecedentedly high-resolution picture of the TCR repertoire provides great potential for revealing
dynamic changes in clonal populations during antigen stimulation.

NGS data or long read data analysis and interpretation.

## Advances Platform

[See all platforms][210]

CD Genomics has established NGS and long-read sequencing platforms designed to meet the most
demanding yet critical needs of basic research and preclinical applications.

[

### PacBio SMRT Sequencing

By taking advantage of the long-read and single molecular sequencing capability developed by PacBio,
we are proud to offer advanced genome de novo assembly solutions and full-length gene/transcript
sequencing strategy to suit your project needs.

Explore now

### Nanopore Sequencing

Nanopore technology for sequencing biomolecules has wide applications in the life sciences,
including identification of pathogens, food safety monitoring, genomic analysis, metagenomic
environmental monitoring, and characterization of bacterial antibiotic resistance.

Explore now

## About Me

I help research teams and clinical labs who have the biology expertise and the data, but need
someone to design, build, or modernise their bioinformatics infrastructure. With nearly 20 years at
the intersection of biology, computing, and systems architecture, I turn raw sequencing data into
analytical workflows that hold up in production.

On one side, code: Bash, AWK, Perl, Python, Groovy, Java, C. On another, infrastructure: HPC,
containers, cloud. In the middle, 20 years of genomics. I design Nextflow pipelines on Google Cloud,
Azure, and OVHcloud, and help teams figure out what compute setup actually makes sense for their
data and their budget.

lightweight custom Nextflow pipelines from the DSL up, when teams need more control, lower cost, or

work daily with BWA, minimap2, HISAT2, samtools, bedtools, and GATK.

go straight to the root of the problem. KIS — Keep It Simple — is not a platitude, it's how I
actually work.

legacy pipelines built in these languages, and knowing them deeply — their idioms, their performance
characteristics, their failure modes — means I can migrate them faithfully to Nextflow without
losing the intent of the original logic. Most bioinformaticians today have never had to debug a
segfault or optimise a tight Perl loop. I have, and that matters when the job is to rewrite
something that works and make it work better.

A few of the organisations I've worked with:

[Institut Pasteur de la Guadeloupe] [Plateforme de Protéomique du CRCHU de Québec] [Institut pour la
Recherche sur le Cancer de Lille] [CHU de Lille] [Qatar Genome Program] [Starfish Biosciences]

Logos shown are used for informational purposes only and remain the property of their respective
organisations.

## Skills
* **Pipeline & Workflow:** Nextflow, Snakemake, Apptainer/Singularity, Docker, Conda/Mamba, CI/CD,
  reproducibility, FAIR principles
* **Genomics & NGS:** WGS/WES, HLA typing (HLA-HD, T1K, HISAT-genotype), variant calling (GATK,
  DRAGEN, samtools), annotation (VEP, SnpEff), QC (FastQC, MultiQC, Mosdepth), metagenomics,
  transcriptomics
* **Infrastructure:** HPC (SLURM, OAR, LSF), cloud (GCP, Azure, OVHcloud), Magic Castle, Terraform,
  Ansible, parallelisation, storage
* **Languages:** Bash, AWK, Python, Groovy, Perl, C, C++, R, Rust

## Professional Experience
* **2025** - Senior Bioinformatics Developer, Starfish Biosciences (France): Joined as technical
  lead for a long-read metagenomic pipeline on OVHcloud HPC. Helped the team get the architecture
  right, set up reproducible workflows with Nextflow and Apptainer, and made sure it would hold up
  as the data volume grew.
* **2024-2025** - Freelance Consultant (France): Helped teams move from ad hoc scripts to
  structured, reproducible pipelines. Advised on compute infrastructure (HPC, cloud) and software
  architecture.
* **2022-2024** - Senior Bioinformatician Scientist, Qatar Genome Program (Qatar): Led the
  development of a specialised HLA reference panel for the Arab population from 29,824 individuals,
  a population historically under-represented in global genomic reference databases, with direct
  implications for organ transplantation and precision medicine. Designed a meta-algorithm
  integrating HISAT-genotype, HLA-HD, and T1K, and developed the data extraction and preparation
  pipeline that underpinned a deep learning model for HLA genotype imputation. Co-led DRAGEN
  integration into the QGP workflow, overseeing reanalysis of a 40k WGS dataset.
* **2013-2021** - Bioinformatics Engineer, CHU de Lille (France): Designed and maintained diagnostic
  sequencing pipelines across 12+ clinical care areas over 8 years: somatic and germline variant
  analysis, clinical microbiology, immunogenetics. Integrated Nextflow for workflow standardisation,
  deployed HPC environments with SLURM/OAR. Clinical compliance and reproducibility were
  non-negotiable.
* **2011-2013** - Bioinformatics Engineer, IRC-Lille (France): Analysed miRNA data for lymphoma
  prognosis research. Developed cluster-based analysis workflows.
* **2009-2010** - Research Professional, CRCHUL (Canada): Built proteomics data integration tools
  and a Ruby-on-Rails LIMS linked to mass spec analysis platforms.
* **2006-2008** - Bioinformatic Software Engineer, Institut Pasteur de Guadeloupe: Developed
  genotyping database systems and data mining tools for tuberculosis research.

## Publications & Talks
* **2024** — Talk · SHLARC-SIP Symposium on Immunoinformatics, Nantes, France: *Navigating HLA
  Typing Challenges in a Population-Wide Whole-Genome Sequencing Project*.
* **2023** — Poster · ASHG Annual Meeting: *Developing a shareable HLA imputation reference panel
  for the Arab population*. Demay C. et al.
* **2018** — Training · [Lille Bioinformatics Engineers Network][11]: *Nextflow training*,
  co-organised with Université de Lille. Trainers: Paolo Di Tommaso and Evan Floden (CRG,
  Barcelona).
* **2018** — Seminar · [Lille Bioinformatics Engineers Network][12]: *Utilisation du framework
  Nextflow pour le soin et la recherche en bioinformatique*. Demay C., Bonte F., Lemoine F.
* **2016** — Seminar · [Lille Bioinformatics Engineers Network][13]: *Docker, BioShadock et
  Go-Docker*. Organised by Demay C.

Earlier work
* **2012** — Journal article · *Infection, Genetics and Evolution*, 12(4):755–66: SITVITWEB — A
  publicly available international multimarker database for studying *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*
  genetic diversity and molecular epidemiology. Demay C. et al.
  [doi:10.1016/j.meegid.2012.02.004][14] — 680+ citations.
* **2008** — Conference · 29th Annual Congress of the European Society of Microbacteriology (ESM),
  Plovdiv, Bulgaria: *Tuberculosis — a global emergency: an overview of methods and tools to
  control, understand and track the TB epidemic worldwide*. Demay C., Zozio T., Millet J., Rastogi
  N.
* **2008** — Conference · Research on Infectious Diseases: A Global Challenge, Institut Pasteur
  Network, Paris: *Tuberculosis in the French Departments of the Americas: Epidemiology, drug
  resistance and geographical tracking of the major genotypic lineages of Mycobacterium
  tuberculosis*. Millet J. et al. (incl. Demay C.)

## Open Resources

Tools and guides I've built for the bioinformatics community:

### [AWK Bioinformatics Cookbook][15]

Practical AWK and gawk recipes for genomics, organised by problem: FASTQ, FASTA, VCF, BED/GFF,
two-file joins, and more.

### [Magic Castle on OVHcloud][16]

Community guide for deploying a SLURM HPC cluster on OVHcloud with Magic Castle, based on hands-on
experience and testing.

### [I Love Testing][17]

A hands-on resource for teams who want to write more reliable bioinformatics pipelines.

## Contact Me

Describe your project in 2–3 lines — I'll get back to you within 48 hours.

Email

* **Languages:** Bash, AWK, Python, Groovy, Perl, C, C++, R, Rust

## Professional Experience
* **2025** - Senior Bioinformatics Developer, Starfish Biosciences (France): Joined as technical
  lead for a long-read metagenomic pipeline on OVHcloud HPC. Helped the team get the architecture
  right, set up reproducible workflows with Nextflow and Apptainer, and made sure it would hold up
  as the data volume grew.
* **2024-2025** - Freelance Consultant (France): Helped teams move from ad hoc scripts to
  structured, reproducible pipelines. Advised on compute infrastructure (HPC, cloud) and software
  architecture.
* **2022-2024** - Senior Bioinformatician Scientist, Qatar Genome Program (Qatar): Led the
  development of a specialised HLA reference panel for the Arab population from 29,824 individuals,
  a population historically under-represented in global genomic reference databases, with direct
  implications for organ transplantation and precision medicine. Designed a meta-algorithm
  integrating HISAT-genotype, HLA-HD, and T1K, and developed the data extraction and preparation
  pipeline that underpinned a deep learning model for HLA genotype imputation. Co-led DRAGEN
  integration into the QGP workflow, overseeing reanalysis of a 40k WGS dataset.
* **2013-2021** - Bioinformatics Engineer, CHU de Lille (France): Designed and maintained diagnostic
  sequencing pipelines across 12+ clinical care areas over 8 years: somatic and germline variant
  analysis, clinical microbiology, immunogenetics. Integrated Nextflow for workflow standardisation,
  deployed HPC environments with SLURM/OAR. Clinical compliance and reproducibility were
  non-negotiable.
* **2011-2013** - Bioinformatics Engineer, IRC-Lille (France): Analysed miRNA data for lymphoma
  prognosis research. Developed cluster-based analysis workflows.
* **2009-2010** - Research Professional, CRCHUL (Canada): Built proteomics data integration tools
  and a Ruby-on-Rails LIMS linked to mass spec analysis platforms.
* **2006-2008** - Bioinformatic Software Engineer, Institut Pasteur de Guadeloupe: Developed
  genotyping database systems and data mining tools for tuberculosis research.

## Publications & Talks
* **2024** — Talk · SHLARC-SIP Symposium on Immunoinformatics, Nantes, France: *Navigating HLA
  Typing Challenges in a Population-Wide Whole-Genome Sequencing Project*.
* **2023** — Poster · ASHG Annual Meeting: *Developing a shareable HLA imputation reference panel
  for the Arab population*. Demay C. et al.
* **2018** — Training · [Lille Bioinformatics Engineers Network][11]: *Nextflow training*,
  co-organised with Université de Lille. Trainers: Paolo Di Tommaso and Evan Floden (CRG,
  Barcelona).
* **2018** — Seminar · [Lille Bioinformatics Engineers Network][12]: *Utilisation du framework
  Nextflow pour le soin et la recherche en bioinformatique*. Demay C., Bonte F., Lemoine F.
* **2016** — Seminar · [Lille Bioinformatics Engineers Network][13]: *Docker, BioShadock et
  Go-Docker*. Organised by Demay C.

Earlier work
* **2012** — Journal article · *Infection, Genetics and Evolution*, 12(4):755–66: SITVITWEB — A
  publicly available international multimarker database for studying *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*
  genetic diversity and molecular epidemiology. Demay C. et al.
  [doi:10.1016/j.meegid.2012.02.004][14] — 680+ citations.
* **2008** — Conference · 29th Annual Congress of the European Society of Microbacteriology (ESM),
  Plovdiv, Bulgaria: *Tuberculosis — a global emergency: an overview of methods and tools to
  control, understand and track the TB epidemic worldwide*. Demay C., Zozio T., Millet J., Rastogi
  N.
* **2008** — Conference · Research on Infectious Diseases: A Global Challenge, Institut Pasteur
  Network, Paris: *Tuberculosis in the French Departments of the Americas: Epidemiology, drug
  resistance and geographical tracking of the major genotypic lineages of Mycobacterium
  tuberculosis*. Millet J. et al. (incl. Demay C.)

## Open Resources

Tools and guides I've built for the bioinformatics community:

### [AWK Bioinformatics Cookbook][15]

Practical AWK and gawk recipes for genomics, organised by problem: FASTQ, FASTA, VCF, BED/GFF,
two-file joins, and more.

### [Magic Castle on OVHcloud][16]

Community guide for deploying a SLURM HPC cluster on OVHcloud with Magic Castle, based on hands-on
experience and testing.

### [I Love Testing][17]

A hands-on resource for teams who want to write more reliable bioinformatics pipelines.

# Expertise-Driven Support for Every Stage from *In Silico* to *In Vivo*

Integrated R&D Solutions CD ComputaBio combines the power of computational modeling with biological
validation. We provide seamless, end-to-end support for your pharmaceutical, NHP, or diagnostic
innovations—from initial concept to pre-clinical testing.

[Contact Us][133] [Explore Our Services][134]

## Dedicated to Computational Biology

CD ComputaBio is a reliable partner for pharmaceutical companies and research institutions
worldwide. We leverage the latest High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Artificial Intelligence (AI)
to provide comprehensive computational biology services.
* **Expert Team:** Scientists with extensive experience in pharmaceutical R&D and academic research.
* **Advanced Platform:** State-of-the-art hardware and a comprehensive suite of commercial and
  open-source software.
* **Custom Solutions:** Tailored strategies designed to meet the specific needs of your project.

## Application Scenarios

We leverage high-performance computing and AI to empower researchers across a wide spectrum of drug
discovery and molecular engineering disciplines.

[

### Drug Discovery

Accelerate lead generation through AI-driven virtual screening of billions of compounds and
precision molecular docking.

[Molecular Dynamics Analysis]
][136]

### Lead Optimization

Enhance binding affinity and ADMET properties using multi-parameter structural refinement and
bioactivity predictions.

### mRNA Therapeutics

Optimize mRNA sequence stability and design lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery systems through
structural modeling.

### Multi-omics Analysis

Integrate genomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data to uncover complex biological mechanisms and
disease biomarkers.

### Enzyme Engineering

Redesign catalysts with enhanced activity and thermal stability for pharmaceutical and industrial
applications.

### Chemical Reaction & Materials

Predict reaction kinetics and functional material properties through advanced quantum mechanics and
molecular simulations.

[Plan Your Research][137]

What We Do

## Our Core Services

Comprehensive computational solutions covering the entire drug discovery pipeline, from target
identification to lead optimization.

[Molecular Modeling Service]

### Molecular Modeling

We investigate the structure, dynamics, and thermodynamics of complex biological systems using
state-of-the-art simulations.
* Protein Modeling & Refinement
* Antibody Structure Modeling
* Small Molecule Modeling

[Read More →][138]
[Drug Design Service]

### Drug Design

Our platform integrates structure-based and ligand-based strategies to accelerate the discovery of
novel therapeutic agents.
* De Novo Drug Design
* Fragment-Based Drug Design
* Lead Optimization

[Read More →][139]
[Virtual Screening Service]

### Virtual Screening

Rapidly screen millions of compounds identifying high-potential hits using advanced scoring
algorithms.
* Structure-Based (SBVS)
* Ligand-Based (LBVS)
* Compound Library Design

[Read More →][140]
[Drug Development Service]

### Drug Development

End-to-end computational support including ADMET prediction, toxicity assessment, and drug
repurposing.
* Target Identification
* Drug Repositioning
* *In Silico* ADMET

[Read More →][141]
[Computational Chemistry Service]

### Computational Chemistry

Applying advanced quantum mechanics to solve complex reaction kinetics and spectroscopic properties.
* Quantum Calculations
* Spectrum Prediction
* Chemical Properties

[Read More →][142]
[Molecular Docking Service]

### Molecular Docking

Accurately predict preferred orientation and binding affinity of small molecules or proteins to
targets.
* Protein-Small Molecule
* Protein-Protein Docking
* Antibody-Antigen Docking

[Read More →][143]

[View All Services][144]

R&D INSIGHTS

## Success Case Studies

Explore how our computational platform solves real-world drug discovery and molecular engineering
challenges.

[GSK3b Inhibitors Study]
Drug Discovery

### Accelerating Drug Discovery: *In Silico* Identification and Stability Validation of Enzyme
### Inhibitors

This study demonstrates a high-efficiency workflow combining virtual screening and MD simulations to
identify novel Enzyme inhibitors with superior binding stability. These findings provide a powerful
computational framework for the rational design of potent enzyme antagonists, offering promising
therapeutic leads for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and type 2 diabetes.

Case details coming soon →
[SWCNTs Biomolecules Interaction]
Nanotechnology

### *In Silico* Study on the Interaction Mechanism of Single-Walled Carbon Nanotubes (SWCNTs) with
### Biomolecules

We utilized 100ns MD simulations, MM/GBSA calculations, and Residue Interaction Network (RIN)
analysis to reveal how SWCNTs embed into specific protein subdomains through strong hydrophobic
interactions, significantly perturbing structural stability.

[ Read the full case study report → ][145]

### Accelerating Drug Discovery: *In Silico* Identification and Stability Validation of Enzyme
### Inhibitors

This study demonstrates a high-efficiency workflow combining virtual screening and MD simulations to
identify novel Enzyme inhibitors with superior binding stability. These findings provide a powerful
computational framework for the rational design of potent enzyme antagonists, offering promising
therapeutic leads for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and type 2 diabetes.

### *In Silico* Study on the Interaction Mechanism of Single-Walled Carbon Nanotubes (SWCNTs) with
### Biomolecules

We utilized 100ns MD simulations, MM/GBSA calculations, and Residue Interaction Network (RIN)
analysis to reveal how SWCNTs embed into specific protein subdomains through strong hydrophobic
interactions, significantly perturbing structural stability.

# FAQs

FAQ Section
What is the difference between genetic testing and DNA testing? ▼
Genetic testing is a broader term that refers to the analysis of DNA to identify genetic disorders,
traits, or risks for various health conditions. DNA testing typically refers to specific analyses
that provide insights into aspects like ancestry, health risks, or personalized recommendations
based on genetic information.
Are the results from DNA tests 100% accurate? ▼
While our DNA tests are highly accurate, no test can guarantee 100% accuracy due to various factors
such as genetic variability and the limitations of current technology. We use the most advanced and
reliable methods available to ensure precise results.
How do I interpret my DNA test results? ▼
Our comprehensive reports are designed to be user-friendly and easy to understand. Additionally, we
offer genetic counseling to help you interpret your results and provide personalized recommendations
based on your genetic profile.
Can DNA testing predict future health conditions? ▼
DNA testing can identify genetic predispositions or risks for certain health conditions, but it
cannot predict future health with certainty. It helps assess your risk based on your genetic makeup,
allowing you to take preventive measures or make lifestyle changes.
Are there any risks associated with DNA testing? ▼
DNA testing is generally safe and non-invasive, with minimal risk. The primary concern is privacy
and the secure handling of your genetic data. We implement strict data protection protocols to
ensure your information remains confidential.
Click More
How often should I get a DNA test? ▼
The frequency of DNA testing depends on your specific needs and health goals. While Germline DNA
tests are Once in a lifetime test, Somatic DNA tests such as those for disease risk, might be done
periodically to track changes or reassess your health strategies.
What should I do if I have questions about my results? ▼
If you have any questions or concerns about your results, please contact our customer support (+91
9310870544) team or schedule a consultation with one of our genetic counselors. We’re here to help
you understand your results and provide guidance.
When will I receive my DNA report? ▼
You will receive your DNA report within a specified timeframe, typically between 2-3 weeks after we
receive your sample. We will notify you when your report is ready for you.
Can I update my DNA profile if my health changes? ▼
While your genetic profile remains constant, you may choose to update other aspects of your
health-related information through new tests or assessments. We offer various testing services to
help you stay informed about different aspects of your health.
What kind of sample is required for DNA testing? ▼
Most DNA tests require a simple saliva sample or a cheek swab, while some may require 2ml blood.
Detailed instructions are provided with your test kit, and the collection process is straightforward
and non-invasive.
Can I track the status of my DNA test? ▼
Yes, once your sample is received, you can track the status of your DNA test through our online
portal or customer service team. We provide updates on the progress of your testing and notify you
when your results are ready.
How long is my DNA sample stored? ▼
We store your DNA profile in digital format for a specified period in accordance with our privacy
policies and regulatory requirements. If you have concerns about storage, please contact our
customer service for specific information.
What happens if I get an inconclusive result? ▼
In rare cases, a result may be inconclusive due to sample quality or other factors. We will notify
you if this occurs and offer options for retesting or further analysis as needed.
Do you offer international shipping for DNA test kits? ▼
Yes, we offer international shipping for our DNA test kits. Please check our website for shipping
options and details to ensure availability in your region.
Are there any age restrictions for DNA testing? ▼
Most DNA tests can be performed on individuals of all ages. For minors, parental consent is
generally required. Please refer to our guidelines for specific age-related requirements.
Is your service available in my city? ▼
Yes. We ship our DNA test kits to almost every city. Just select your city during checkout.
What will happen to my sample once it goes to the lab? ▼
Once your sample reaches our lab, it will be processed according to our rigorous protocols. We
analyze the DNA to generate your results, which are then reviewed and compiled into a comprehensive
report

# FAQs

FAQ Section
What is the difference between genetic testing and DNA testing? ▼
Genetic testing is a broader term that refers to the analysis of DNA to identify genetic disorders,
traits, or risks for various health conditions. DNA testing typically refers to specific analyses
that provide insights into aspects like ancestry, health risks, or personalized recommendations
based on genetic information.
Are the results from DNA tests 100% accurate? ▼
While our DNA tests are highly accurate, no test can guarantee 100% accuracy due to various factors
such as genetic variability and the limitations of current technology. We use the most advanced and
reliable methods available to ensure precise results.
How do I interpret my DNA test results? ▼
Our comprehensive reports are designed to be user-friendly and easy to understand. Additionally, we
offer genetic counseling to help you interpret your results and provide personalized recommendations
based on your genetic profile.
Can DNA testing predict future health conditions? ▼
DNA testing can identify genetic predispositions or risks for certain health conditions, but it
cannot predict future health with certainty. It helps assess your risk based on your genetic makeup,
allowing you to take preventive measures or make lifestyle changes.
Are there any risks associated with DNA testing? ▼
DNA testing is generally safe and non-invasive, with minimal risk. The primary concern is privacy
and the secure handling of your genetic data. We implement strict data protection protocols to
ensure your information remains confidential.
Click More
How often should I get a DNA test? ▼
The frequency of DNA testing depends on your specific needs and health goals. While Germline DNA
tests are Once in a lifetime test, Somatic DNA tests such as those for disease risk, might be done
periodically to track changes or reassess your health strategies.
What should I do if I have questions about my results? ▼
If you have any questions or concerns about your results, please contact our customer support (+91
9310870544) team or schedule a consultation with one of our genetic counselors. We’re here to help
you understand your results and provide guidance.
When will I receive my DNA report? ▼
You will receive your DNA report within a specified timeframe, typically between 2-3 weeks after we
receive your sample. We will notify you when your report is ready for you.
Can I update my DNA profile if my health changes? ▼
While your genetic profile remains constant, you may choose to update other aspects of your
health-related information through new tests or assessments. We offer various testing services to
help you stay informed about different aspects of your health.
What kind of sample is required for DNA testing? ▼
Most DNA tests require a simple saliva sample or a cheek swab, while some may require 2ml blood.
Detailed instructions are provided with your test kit, and the collection process is straightforward
and non-invasive.
Can I track the status of my DNA test? ▼
Yes, once your sample is received, you can track the status of your DNA test through our online
portal or customer service team. We provide updates on the progress of your testing and notify you
when your results are ready.
How long is my DNA sample stored? ▼
We store your DNA profile in digital format for a specified period in accordance with our privacy
policies and regulatory requirements. If you have concerns about storage, please contact our
customer service for specific information.
What happens if I get an inconclusive result? ▼
In rare cases, a result may be inconclusive due to sample quality or other factors. We will notify
you if this occurs and offer options for retesting or further analysis as needed.
Do you offer international shipping for DNA test kits? ▼
Yes, we offer international shipping for our DNA test kits. Please check our website for shipping
options and details to ensure availability in your region.
Are there any age restrictions for DNA testing? ▼
Most DNA tests can be performed on individuals of all ages. For minors, parental consent is
generally required. Please refer to our guidelines for specific age-related requirements.
Is your service available in my city? ▼
Yes. We ship our DNA test kits to almost every city. Just select your city during checkout.
What will happen to my sample once it goes to the lab? ▼
Once your sample reaches our lab, it will be processed according to our rigorous protocols. We
analyze the DNA to generate your results, which are then reviewed and compiled into a comprehensive
report

## The Epistem Approach

[
About ][137]

Epistem prides itself on its commitment to providing reliable, innovative, and transferable models,
platforms and services to support decision making throughout the drug discovery, development, and
early clinical pipeline. With a track record of working with over 200 pharmaceutical and
biotechnology companies, we offer preclinical and clinical services that you can count on.

Our preclinical services include both in vitro and in vivo models, with a focus on oncology and
inflammatory diseases, as well as extensive experience in the gastrointestinal disease area,
including GI toxicities. We also offer organoid models for the modelling of complex physiological
systems and diseases.

Our GCLP-accredited laboratories also support clinical trials, providing histology, IHC and Image
Analysis, gene expression and DNA genotyping services.

We are proud to offer specialist research services that provide invaluable support to drug discovery
and development pipelines. Our experienced and highly skilled technical team is dedicated to
delivering custom protocols and personalised services of the utmost quality, tailored specifically
to meet your needs.

Contact us today to learn more about how we can help you achieve your research goals.

FasterCapital is a global venture builder and online incubator dedicated to co-funding and
co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of
number of startups that we have helped, money invested and money raised. We have supported over 1620
startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

co-founding innovative startups. Established in 2014, we are now #1 venture builder in terms of

startups in raising more than $2.8 billion, while directly investing over 1 billion in 1145
companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],
[investors][167], and [strategic partners][168], allowing us to transform ideas into scalable,
market-ready businesses.

# From Complex Data to Actionable Discovery

Transforming genomic data into meaningful insights for academic, clinical, and pharmaceutical
research. Accelerating discoveries that matter.

[ Explore Our Solutions ][43] [ Request a Quote ][44]

## How We Simplify Bioinformatics

Our streamlined process ensures you get from data to discovery, faster and more efficiently than
ever before.

1

### Data Submission

Securely upload your raw data through our easy-to-use portal with automated validation.

2

### Analysis & Interpretation

Our experts use proprietary pipelines and AI algorithms to analyze and interpret your data.

3

### Actionable Reports

Receive comprehensive, publication-ready reports with clear insights and visualizations.

## Our Bioinformatics Services

Comprehensive analysis solutions tailored to your research needs

### Genomics

Whole genome, exome, and targeted sequencing analysis with advanced variant calling and annotation.
* Variant Discovery & Annotation
* Family-based Analysis
* CNV/SV Detection

[ Learn More ][45]

### Transcriptomics

RNA-Seq analysis for differential expression, pathway enrichment, and functional annotation.
* Differential Expression
* Pathway Analysis
* Alternative Splicing

[ Learn More ][46]

### Metagenomics

Microbial community profiling and functional analysis from 16S and shotgun sequencing data.
* Taxonomic Classification
* Functional Profiling
* Diversity Analysis

[ Learn More ][47]

### Epigenomics

Analysis of DNA methylation, histone modifications, and chromatin accessibility data.
* DNA Methylation Analysis
* ChIP-Seq Analysis
* ATAC-Seq Processing

[ Learn More ][48]

### Single-Cell Analysis

Single-cell RNA-Seq analysis for cellular heterogeneity and developmental trajectories.
* Cell Clustering
* Trajectory Inference
* Differential Expression

[ Learn More ][49]

### Custom Solutions

Tailored bioinformatics pipelines and analysis workflows for specific research questions.
* Pipeline Development
* Script Optimization
* Cloud Integration

[ Learn More ][50]
[ See All Service ][51]

## Our Platform Suite

Proprietary platforms designed to accelerate your research workflow

### GeneAssure Platform

Cloud-based NGS analysis platform

[GeneAssure Platform]

An integrated platform for streamlined NGS data analysis, visualization, and collaborative research
management.
* Automated pipeline execution with version control
* Interactive visualization dashboard
* Team collaboration tools
* Secure data storage and sharing

[ Explore Platform ][52]

### RareVarDB

Curated rare variant database

[RareVarDB]

A comprehensive database of clinically annotated rare genetic variants with population frequency
data and pathogenicity predictions.
* Clinically annotated variants from global populations
* 20+ in-silico prediction scores
* Real-time updates from literature
* API access for integration

[ Access Database ][53]

Driving discoveries through data since 2020

Ready to transform your data into discoveries? Get in touch with our expert team.

GeneSpectrum Life Sciences is a Bioinformatics services company. We Simplify Bioinformatics with our

solution for your Genomics and Bioinformatics problems.

# The Most Reliable Way to Order NGS Services from Top Providers.

#### One-stop shop for NGS services

Quickly find next-generation sequencing and bioinformatics services from our network of over 100
partnering providers. Our experienced NGS specialists help you along the way to find the right
service for your project. We offer free scientific consultation to help define your project.

#### Order with peace of mind

All Genohub projects are covered by our quality and turnaround time guarantees. We actively
supervise your project and help resolve any issues quickly. Providers perform better when Genohub
has your back and they don't get paid until the project is completed to your satisfaction.

#### Track and manage your projects

Our secure online project management tools allow you and your collaborators to easily accept quotes,
track your project, communicate with the provider and share files. All your project-related
information is protected by our strict confidentiality policy.

#### One relationship

When you use Genohub you get access to our curated network of top NGS service providers, while your
organization only has to deal with a single vendor for service terms and payments. Most institutions
prefer working with one CRO to reduce purchase order paperwork. With Genohub you can do that without
limiting your choices.

#### Data storage and transfer

At no extra cost, each Genohub project includes:

- Unlimited storage all project data for 3 months
- Fast, secure and reliable data transfer
- Private project bucket with secure access keys

#### Fast response times

When you submit a request or ask us a question our typical response time is less than 2 hours. Once
your project specifications are confirmed we can typically get you instant estimates and a confirmed
quote in less than 24 hours. We actively follow-up with our partners to make sure you always get a
fast response

# The Most Reliable Way to Order NGS Services from Top Providers.

#### One-stop shop for NGS services

Quickly find next-generation sequencing and bioinformatics services from our network of over 100
partnering providers. Our experienced NGS specialists help you along the way to find the right
service for your project. We offer free scientific consultation to help define your project.

#### Order with peace of mind

All Genohub projects are covered by our quality and turnaround time guarantees. We actively
supervise your project and help resolve any issues quickly. Providers perform better when Genohub
has your back and they don't get paid until the project is completed to your satisfaction.

#### Track and manage your projects

Our secure online project management tools allow you and your collaborators to easily accept quotes,
track your project, communicate with the provider and share files. All your project-related
information is protected by our strict confidentiality policy.

#### One relationship

When you use Genohub you get access to our curated network of top NGS service providers, while your
organization only has to deal with a single vendor for service terms and payments. Most institutions
prefer working with one CRO to reduce purchase order paperwork. With Genohub you can do that without
limiting your choices.

#### Data storage and transfer

At no extra cost, each Genohub project includes:

- Unlimited storage all project data for 3 months
- Fast, secure and reliable data transfer
- Private project bucket with secure access keys

#### Fast response times

When you submit a request or ask us a question our typical response time is less than 2 hours. Once
your project specifications are confirmed we can typically get you instant estimates and a confirmed
quote in less than 24 hours. We actively follow-up with our partners to make sure you always get a

# Welcome to my Home Page


I am **Dr. István Albert** and I am a **Research Professor of Bioinformatics** at the [Pennsylvania
State University][17]

My research career spans three scientific fields: bioinformatics, computer science, and statistical
physics.

Currently, my primary focus is bioinformatics, where I pursue both independent research and
collaborative projects through the **Bioinformatics Consulting Center**, which I direct. In this
role, I advise and work with scientists and students from a broad range of disciplines.
* [ORCID profile »][18] my researcher identifier
* [Google Scholar »][19] keeps track of what I've published
* [Biostars profile »][20] where I spend my social media time

## Contact Information

`Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
Pennsylvania State University. 
Office: 206C Life Sciences Building 
Email: iua1@psu.edu
`

## Bioinformatics Teaching

I teach **BMMB 852: Applied Bioinformatics** as part of the resident instruction program.
* Fall 2025: Mon/Wed 1:25PM - 2:15PM, Business Bld 102

The course typically reaches capacity soon after registration opens, so early enrollment is
recommended.

## Bioinformatics Consulting

I am the director of the **Bioinformatics Consulting Center (BCC)** at Penn State, which provides
bioinformatics data analysis services across the full range of high-throughput sequencing
applications.

Our work spans from routine data processing to the development of novel, domain-specific
methodologies. To date, we have contributed to hundreds of projects across the life sciences.

The center also manages and distributes sequencing data generated by the **Penn State Genomics Core
Sequencing Facilities**.

Penn State affiliates interested in our services may contact me at `iua1@psu.edu`

## The Biostar Handbook

Bioinformatics education remains inadequate worldwide. Much of the coursework fails to provide
sufficient training, leading to persistent misconceptions and fallacies.

Substantial resources are wasted on ineffective formats such as weekend workshops, recipe-style
guides, and over-automated tutorials - that create an illusion of learning without building genuine
problem-solving skills.

To address this gap, I developed the [Biostar Handbook][21]. What began as a single volume has since
expanded into a series dedicated to practical bioinformatics data analysis.

────────────────────┬─────────────────────┬─────────────────┬────────────────────┬──────────────────
[The Biostar        │[Bioinformatics      │[RNA-Seq         │[Coronavirus        │[Biostar          
Handbook][22]       │Scripting][23]       │Analysis][24]    │Analysis][25]       │Workflows][26]    
────────────────────┴─────────────────────┴─────────────────┴────────────────────┴──────────────────

The Biostar Handbook series introduces readers to bioinformatics—a discipline at the intersection of
biology, computer science, and statistical data analysis—focused on the digital processing of
genomic information.
* [The Biostar Handbook][27] - An introduction to Bioinformatics as a scientific field.
* [The Art of Bioinformatics Scripting][28] - Learn advanced Unix and Bash scripting skills.
* [RNA-Seq by Example][29] - Master RNA-Seq data analysis.
* [Corona Virus Genome Analysis][30] - Advanced topics devoted to the study of the Coronavirus.
* [Biostar Workflows][31] - Best practices for developing bioinformatics pipelines.

## Biostar Q&A Forum

More than fifteen years ago, I founded [Biostars: Question and Answer][32], an open-source platform
designed to support and sustain scientific communities.

Today, the site serves a large global audience and has become the most widely visited bioinformatics
information resource in the world.

Over the years, [Biostar-powered][33] sites have supported millions of users and delivered hundreds
of millions of page views. The source code is available at [Biostar Central][34]

## Scientific Software

I also enjoy developing software tools that make complex data easier to explore:
* [genescape][35] — a visualization tool for exploring gene functions
* [bio][36] — a project designed to make bioinformatics fun again

... and many others.

## Weekend Cowboy

Scientist by day, hiker and traveler on weekends. Follow my adventures on my YouTube channel.

# Driving Discovery Through Information Science

INCOGEN is a scientific computing and bioinformatics company founded in 1998 to advance data-driven
discovery in biology, medicine, and translational research.

We develop analytical platforms and methodologies spanning genomics, systems biology, and
personalized medicine, bridging computational innovation with real-world biomedical applications.

For nearly three decades, our experts have engaged with hundreds of corporations, institutes, and
laboratories world-wide, offering a full range of scientific research support to assist in the
successful design, development and implementation of their projects.

[ [Research]

## Research

Computational methods, analytical platforms, and applied bioinformatics initiatives in genomics,
systems biology, translational research, and personalized medicine.

Explore research → ][9] [ [Technologies]

## Technologies

LabrePort, our latest product, provides laboratories with a sophisticated platform to manage and
track samples (approved for facilities up to BSL-4).

View technologies → ][10] [ [News]

## Latest News

Healthy aging: one size does not fit all. A thought-provoking article about the need for an
integrative, preventive, and tailored approach for healthy living.

Discover our comprehensive bioinformatics services and statistical data analysis solutions to help
you transform lives and improve human health. 




[ Our services ][43]

## Make your data analysis efficient

KonAnBio specialises in bioinformatics solutions, providing healthcare practitioners with flexible
and customizable services required to effectively analyse and manage vast quantities of data. Our
complete services are offered either as standalone or in conjunction with our Next Generation
Sequencing Services. We use leading-edge technology to help you put science into improving human
health. Whatever the project or the area you are working on, in addition to various bioinformatics
solutions, you will benefits from support every stage of the process.

### DNA sequencing data analysis

DNA sequencing is a general laboratory technique used to identify and analyse genetic variants that
make up the DNA molecule. This helps to find out what sort of genetic information is carried in a
particular DNA segment.
[ Read More ][44]

### RNA sequencing data analysis

RNA-sequencing examines the quantity and sequences of RNA in a sample using next-generation
sequencing. By using RNA-seq scientists can better understand a cell biology and assess abnormal
changes that may indicate disease.
[ Read More ][45]

### Single-cell RNA sequencing data analysis

Single‐cell RNA sequencing is a state‐of‐the‐art approach that can be used to explain the
heterogeneity and complexity of RNA transcripts within individual cells, to better understand health
and diseases.
[ Read More ][46]

### Epigenomic data analysis

Epigenomics is the study of epigenetic modifications across the entire genome of an organism.
Epigenetics refers to heritable changes in gene function that do not involve alterations to the
underlying DNA sequence. Instead, these changes involve modifications to DNA molecules or associated
proteins, influencing gene expression and cellular function.
[ Read More ][47]

### Proteomic data analysis

Proteomics deals with the study of all the expressed proteins in an organism. With Pproteomics
analysis you have a better understanding of the structure and function of the organism. More
specific, proteomics look at how different proteins interact with each other and the roles they play
within the organism.
[ Read More ][48]

### Metagenomics data analysis

Metagenomics deals with the study of the structure and function of entire nucleotide sequences
isolated and analysed from all the organisms. This type of analysis is often used to study a
specific community of microorganisms, such as those residing on human skin, in the soil or in a
water sample. Metagenomics explores a mixture of DNA from multiple organisms and entities, such as
viruses, viroids and free DNA.
[ Read More ][49]

therapeutics with the latest technology to provide expert bioinformatics services and innovative
computational solutions to science companies from all over the world. Our company has experience in
providing bioinformatics services and statistical data analysis solutions for small and large
projects, including clinical trials and research.

projects, KenAnBio was set-up to offer tailored data analysis solutions for healthcare professionals
that want to advance their preclinical and translational research programs, as well as their

improve your results.

We have been working on interpreting and analysing clinical data using gene expression profiles,

We hold PhD and Masters in Science and we can provide data analysis and interpretation for clinical

We can support drug target identification and validation and we can develop biomarkers, and the
necessary genomic tools to maximise the therapeutic benefit of drugs.

## Accelerate your research with expert bioinformatics services

Have something in mind? Combining experience, knowledge and machine intelligence our company can
create a customised service solution to meet your sequencing needs and maximise your omics data
value.

## Comprehensive omics services ensuring high-quality data

We analyze omics data from sequencing, array and mass-spec experiments

Transcriptomic Analysis

Our company provides the following transcriptomic data analysis services:
* Total RNA-seq analysis
* mRNA-seq analysis
* small RNA-seq analysis
* single-cell RNA-seq analysis
* LncRNA-seq
* Ribo-seq
* Gene expression analysis from bulk or single-cell RNA-seq data
* CAGE-seq

Genomic Analysis

At KonAnBio we offer the following genomic data analysis services:
* Whole Genome Sequencing analysis (WGS)
* Whole Exome Sequencing analysis (WES)
* De novo sequencing data analysis
* Variant analysis
* Genome resequencing data analysis
* Annotation and gene prediction
* Targeted and Exome data analysis

Metagenomics Analysis

Metagenomics studies are used to understand what microbes are present and what they are doing in a
particular environment. At KonAnBio we offer:
* 16s/18s/ITS Amplicon sequencing,
* Metagenomic Shotgun sequencing
* Microbial Whole Genome sequencing
* Microbial Identification

Protemics Analysis

Our company has extensive experience in proteomics data, especially the analysis of biological
pathways and networks, and rapid discovery of large amounts of protein interaction data. We are able
to offer: 
* Protein Identification
* Protein sequence analysis
* Protein structural alignment
* Quantitative Protein analysis
* Protein Functional analysis

Epigeneomics Analysis

treatment. Some of our epigenomic sequencing solutions include:
* Bisulfite-seq
* ChIP-seq
* ATAC-seq
* MeDIP-seq
* RIP-seq
* DAP-seq

Other bioinformatics services
* CRISPR sequencing
* Immune Repertoire sequencing
* Target discovery and validation
* Discovery of genetic variants
* Custom panels
* Comparative genome analysis

We would love to hear about your research so our expert team of scientists can build a pipeline to

* Accurate top results delivered on time
* Provide support every step of the project

specific, proteomics look at how different proteins interact with each other and the roles they play
within the organism.
[ Read More ][48]

### Metagenomics data analysis

Metagenomics deals with the study of the structure and function of entire nucleotide sequences
isolated and analysed from all the organisms. This type of analysis is often used to study a
specific community of microorganisms, such as those residing on human skin, in the soil or in a
water sample. Metagenomics explores a mixture of DNA from multiple organisms and entities, such as
viruses, viroids and free DNA.
[ Read More ][49]

## Transform lives. Improve human health

At KonAnBio we combine our experience in basic research, technology development, diagnostics, and
therapeutics with the latest technology to provide expert bioinformatics services and innovative
computational solutions to science companies from all over the world. Our company has experience in
providing bioinformatics services and statistical data analysis solutions for small and large
projects, including clinical trials and research. 

After more than a decade of experience in computer science and technology, working on various
projects, KenAnBio was set-up to offer tailored data analysis solutions for healthcare professionals
that want to advance their preclinical and translational research programs, as well as their
clinical programs. As scientists ourselves we understand how hard it can be getting things done on
time. By partnering with us you will benefit from fast, reliable and flexible services that will
improve your results. 

### Areas covered

## We provide a wide range of bioinformatics data analysis solutions for different areas of science.

### Clinical

We have been working on interpreting and analysing clinical data using gene expression profiles,
proteomics, and sequencing data.

[ READ MORE ][50]

### Research and academia

We hold PhD and Masters in Science and we can provide data analysis and interpretation for clinical
trials and academia research.

[ READ MORE ][51]

### Pharmacology

We can support drug target identification and validation and we can develop biomarkers, and the
necessary genomic tools to maximise the therapeutic benefit of drugs.

[ READ MORE ][52]

## Accelerate your research with expert bioinformatics services

Have something in mind? Combining experience, knowledge and machine intelligence our company can
create a customised service solution to meet your sequencing needs and maximise your omics data
value.

[ Ask for a quote ][53]

## Comprehensive omics services ensuring high-quality data

We analyze omics data from sequencing, array and mass-spec experiments

Transcriptomic Analysis

Our company provides the following transcriptomic data analysis services:
* Total RNA-seq analysis
* mRNA-seq analysis
* small RNA-seq analysis
* single-cell RNA-seq analysis
* LncRNA-seq
* Ribo-seq
* Gene expression analysis from bulk or single-cell RNA-seq data
* CAGE-seq

Genomic Analysis

At KonAnBio we offer the following genomic data analysis services:
* Whole Genome Sequencing analysis (WGS)
* Whole Exome Sequencing analysis (WES)
* De novo sequencing data analysis
* Variant analysis
* Genome resequencing data analysis
* Annotation and gene prediction
* Targeted and Exome data analysis

Metagenomics Analysis

Metagenomics studies are used to understand what microbes are present and what they are doing in a
particular environment. At KonAnBio we offer:
* 16s/18s/ITS Amplicon sequencing,
* Metagenomic Shotgun sequencing
* Microbial Whole Genome sequencing
* Microbial Identification

Protemics Analysis

Our company has extensive experience in proteomics data, especially the analysis of biological
pathways and networks, and rapid discovery of large amounts of protein interaction data. We are able
to offer: 
* Protein Identification
* Protein sequence analysis
* Protein structural alignment
* Quantitative Protein analysis
* Protein Functional analysis

Epigeneomics Analysis

KonAnBio is offering epigenomics analysis that will help scientists identify targets for therapeutic
treatment. Some of our epigenomic sequencing solutions include:
* Bisulfite-seq
* ChIP-seq
* ATAC-seq
* MeDIP-seq
* RIP-seq
* DAP-seq

Other bioinformatics services
* CRISPR sequencing
* Immune Repertoire sequencing
* Target discovery and validation
* Discovery of genetic variants
* Custom panels
* Comparative genome analysis
Customise bioinformatics analysis

We would love to hear about your research so our expert team of scientists can build a pipeline to
meet your requirements.

### Our mission

Our mission is to help healthcare professionals and patients utilise data analysis to find
personalised and better therapy options. We are scientists at heart and our core technology is
next-generation sequencing available in a high-throughput format.
* Flexibile, high-quality and reliable services
* Accurate top results delivered on time
* Provide support every step of the project

### Our process

Our process was designed with the needs of our clients in mind. We know how important it's the work
that you do so we treat every single project with the highest level of responsibility. For rapid
turnaround times and high quality results employ a collaborative approach, combining our
bioinformatic expertise with yours.

* A compressive stage involving planning and collaboration

virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational

# Softwares

[OmicsBox]

# OmicsBox 3.4

Renowned bioinformatics company Biobam S.L. recently launched its new complete bioinformatics
solution named OmicsBox which has replaced Blast2GO completely. OmicsBox is a bioinformatics
software solution that allows getting from reads to insights with ease. Use OmicsBox for the NGS
data analysis of genomes, transcriptomics, and metagenomes. OmicsBox is structured in Modules.
Depending on your needs you can combine different modules required for your data analysis.

[Read more][11]
[Molquest]

# MolQuest 2.4.5

MolQuest is the most comprehensive, easy-to-use desktop application for sequence analysis and
molecular biology data management available in the market today. The package includes versatile
family of gene finders, FGENESH/H+, with parameters for wide variety of genomes, as well as
pipelines for fully automatic annotation of eukaryotic (FGENESH++) and bacterial (FGENESB) genomes,
which proved to be the most accurate gene finding tools overall The package has a user-friendly
interface for sequence editing, primer design, internet database searches, gene prediction, promoter
identification, regulatory elements mapping, patterns discovery protein analysis, multiple sequence
alignment, phylogenetic tree reconstruction, and a wide variety of other functions.

[Read more][12]
[MapQTL]

# MapQTL ® 7

Analyze your QTL experiments with interval mapping, with the powerful MQM mapping (=composite
interval mapping), or with a nonparametric method. MapQTL 7 is easy to use, is very fast, and
presents the analysis results in tables and (adjustable) charts that can be exported to MS-Windows
text processing and presentation software.

[Read more][13]
[JoinMAP]

# JoinMap ® 5

JoinMap ® 5 provides high-quality tools that allow detailed study of the experimental data and the
generation of publication-ready map charts. The intuitive MS Windows user interface of JoinMap
invites a better exploration of the data. For instance, you can perform several diagnostical tests,
both before and after the actual map calculation, and you can remove potentially erroneous loci and
individuals from the map calculations with a simple mouse click.

[Read more][14]
[NTSYS PC]

# NTSYS PC

NTSYSpc can be used to discover pattern and structure in multivariate data. The phylogenetic tree
either using the neighbor-joining or UPGMA methods for constructing dendrograms. NTSYSpc can
transform data, estimate dis/similarities among objects, and prepare summaries of the relationships
using cluster analysis, ordination, and multiple factor analyses. Many of the results can be shown
both numerically and graphically.

[Read more][15]
[personalised_software]

# Personalised Software Development

We understand your needs. Whether you like to have a wrapper to meet your expectations, or you want
to have a novel tool. Our excellent team of programmers help you from scratch to the well suited
software solution to your biological analyses needs.

linkages with top research institutes and universities in India, as well as with leading Private
