together with our international partners and collaborators are committed to provide the best
possible services to the scientific community in India and South Asian region.  We have strong
linkages with top research institutes and universities in India, as well as with leading Private
Sector Companies with R&D facilities.

We have a wide range of pre developed  softwares from our various international partners which are
very useful for a basic to advanced data analyses. Our highly skilled team of software and web
developers are committed to develop customized and efficient softwares / pipelines, web-servers for
bioinformatics tools, Genome browsers for your projects.  We have collaborated with one of the best
technology institutes in the world for the High performance computing for bioinformatics analyses of
structural data. 

Our human resource team is committed to provide the best opportunity to develop your skills through
various training programs. Our training modules have been designed for each and every needy in the
scientific community. Whether you are a beginner to the computers or you have basic skills in
Bioinformatics, our team  bring you the best suited learning opportunities.

Welcome to Rapture Biotech International Private Limited

**Rapture Biotech International Private Limited** is a leading force in **biotech skill
development** and bioservices, dedicated to advancing the global biotechnology industry since 2011.
ISO 9001:2015 certified, we operate with full approval from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs,
Government of India, under the Companies Act 2013 (CIN: U80904UP2017PTC095193), and are proudly
registered with MSME (UP28D0015419).

Our strategic partnership with the Life Science Skill Development Corporation (LSSSDC), Government
of India, reinforces our commitment to shaping the future of biotechnology through world-class
training and services. We aim to empower the next generation of biotech professionals while
contributing to the industry’s continued growth and innovation. Our training institutes are
available in Noida, Chandigarh, Dehradun, Gwalior, Jaipur, Gujarat, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai,

Core Workflow

## From raw FASTQ sequencing reads to validated insights.

Our containerized, reproducible bioinformatics workflows ensure that raw sequencing datasets are
quality controlled, mapped, and mathematically modeled with full scientific rigor.

01
Ingestion & Quality Inspection
Adapter removal, fastp trimming, and automated multi-sample quality control reporting via MultiQC.
02
Alignment & Expression Counting
Ultra-fast genomic mapping using STARSpliced Transcripts Alignment to a Reference - high speed
RNA-seq aligner., HISAT2, or de novo transcripts quantification using Salmon.
03
Signal Modeling & Statistics
Differential expression modeling (DESeq2), cell clustering (Seurat/Scanpy), or variant detection
(GATK4).
04
Reporting & Visual Dashboards
Clean, publication-ready figures, annotated tables, interactive browser dashboards, and Nextflow
pipeline logs.

# Locations

Rosalind is a platform for learning bioinformatics and programming through problem solving. [Take a
tour][19] to get the hang of how Rosalind works.

If you don't know anything about programming, you can start at the [Python Village][20]. For a
collection of exercises to accompany Bioinformatics Algorithms book, go to the [Textbook Track][21].
Otherwise you can try to storm the [Bioinformatics Stronghold][22] right now.

[

Python Village

][23]
If you are completely new to programming, try these initial problems to learn a few basics about the
Python programming language. You'll get familiar with the operations needed to start solving
bioinformatics challenges in the Stronghold.
[

Bioinformatics Stronghold

][24]
Discover the algorithms underlying a variety of bioinformatics topics: computational mass
spectrometry, alignment, dynamic programming, genome assembly, genome rearrangements, phylogeny,
probability, string algorithms and others.
[

Bioinformatics Armory

][25]
Ready-to-use software tools abound for bioinformatics analysis. Whereas in the Stronghold you
implement algorithms on your own, in the Armory you solve similar problems by using existing tools.
[

Bioinformatics Textbook Track

][26]
A collection of exercises to accompany Bioinformatics Algorithms: An Active-Learning Approach by
Phillip Compeau & Pavel Pevzner. A full version of this text is hosted on stepic.org
[

Algorithmic Heights

][27]
A collection of exercises in introductory algorithms to accompany "Algorithms", the popular textbook
by Dasgupta, Papadimitriou, and Vazirani.

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

periodicals, Mergers and Acquisitions along with the SWOT analysis.

overall understanding of the current market scenario.

### Market Share Analysis (MSA)

complete sense of specific market that will impact your revenue.
